Messages.Author: ramst...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Question on Changling.

The card has +1 bleed at normal and
+1 stealth at superior

Could a player play Changling to push a bleed action through and then
play another to augment the bleed?

Example: Player A announces a bleed action with Computer Hacking.

Player B announces his/her intention to block the bleed.

Player A plays Changling at Superior to gain the +1 stealth.

Player B is unable to play any additional intercept, so the bleed
action is successful.

Player A wants to play Changling at Normal to increase the bleed from 2
point pool loss to 3 point pool loss.

Is this legal, considering you are playing the same card (Action
Modifier) twice for a single action even though the modification to the
action was different each time.

Michael Eichler

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ramst...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Question on Changling.
> The card has +1 bleed at normal and
> +1 stealth at superior
>
> Could a player play Changling to push a bleed action through and then
> play another to augment the bleed?

No. "A minion cannot play the same action modifier more than once during
a single action." [1.6.3.2]
